name: Engineering & Process Explainer 3D
description: Engineering explainer look (physical, mechanical and architectural cutaways). For any video built on a persistent `stage` with beats and builders, use `process-explainer` instead: it is the master template and this one only differs in its framing. Cutaway dioramas (earth strata, foundations, piping, structural framing), the 5 engineering archetypes (como-funciona, paso-a-paso, que-paso, para-que-sirve, fuerzas-ingenieria) and the dig, pour, fill, drain, collapse, buoyancy and insert presets still work. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 5-8 scenes (4-8 s) explaining a physical or engineering system. Prefer a top-level `stage` (ONE world for the whole video, built from `{ "build": ... }` calls: see `node cli.mjs builders`) with word-timed `beats` for every state change and camera `shots`; do NOT build a new world per scene and do not rely on loop presets (dig, pour, fill, drain, collapse, buoyancy, insert are only short idle loops: real changes are beats, carve and liquid levels). Parts are rich models (40-150 parts from builders, up to 160 per actor), not 2-6 primitives. Overlays: flow strips, concept pills, limit bars. Captions at the bottom. No emoji.
best_for: failure forensics (what happened / why it failed)
fluid dynamics, valves, and piping networks
